_inherited_budget_note: The 2026/27 budget was set by the outgoing Labour administration (26 Feb 2026). Reform UK won 7 May 2026 (first non-Labour control since 1973) and formed the Cabinet, inheriting the budget; the first Reform-set budget will be 2027/28.

administration.note: Reform UK won the 7 May 2026 all-out election (38 of 66), ending Labour control held since 1973. Leader Cllr Nick Allan (holds the strategic finance/resources remit); Deputy Leader Cllr Fiona Pearce. Part of the North East Mayoral Combined Authority (Mayor Kim McGuinness, Labour).

mtfs.intervention_status: None (no S114, no EFS, no Best Value Notice; benefits from the Recovery Grant Guarantee). DSG High Needs may enter a deficit; no Safety Valve agreement.
mtfs._source: Gateshead MBC 2026/27 Budget report (doc s47925), full Council 26 Feb 2026, pulled and read directly.
